recipe.supervision: Only inserted, separable debris/pushable road obstacles are positive; original void remains ignored
recipe.support: Unique instance-box and semantic-label intersection; open adjacent-beam triangles
recipe.visibility: Nearest triangle intersections on existing measured directions
recipe.normal_control: The same insertion applied to measured normal road users
recipe.pairing: Unmodified original returns are the normal auxiliary reference
recipe.source_view: Rigid road-tangent rotation preserves the primary viewing side and road-relative height
recipe.minimum_target_range: source observation range; no closer-view surface completion
recipe.donor_identity: Official instance token within scene; cross-scene identity is not guaranteed
recipe.evaluation: anomaly >= 5 eligibility; main metrics use reference role; training keeps 1-4 positive points
recipe.reference_distance: Sample a bin proportional to the receiver's measured road-return counts; not natural anomaly prevalence
recipe.control_match: Same range bin, visible-count ratio in [0.5,2], angular-span ratio in [0.5,2] where measurable, overlapping intensity q10-q90
recipe.normal_library: Deterministic instance subset: at most 256 per mapped normal category in train, 64 in val
recipe.allocation: Interleave reference and coverage requests; balance annotated instance, then view-bin use; geometry groups unavailable
recipe.allocation_ties: First 64 SHA256 bits of donor_id XOR request seed; matched controls use donor hash
recipe.shape_holdout: Unavailable without validated cross-instance geometry labels; keep all 600 requested slots unfilled

geometry.method: Official annotated-instance allocation; geometric identity unavailable
geometry.unavailable_reason: Partial visible-surface repeatability does not validate cross-instance shape similarity
geometry.scope: Scene/log and annotated-instance split; no unseen-geometry or cross-scene physical-identity guarantee

range_eligible_definition: Source range below target-bin upper bound is necessary, not sufficient for visible placement; actual outcomes are counted separately.
